name: Respirator feed mixer
design: Tall powerful adult female Yautja, slate mottled hide and long thick scalp tendrils tied back. FULL FACE smooth antique bronze protective stable respirator covers eyes, nose area, entire mouth and all four mandibles; no exposed mouth. Dusty saffron practical sleeveless smock with grey heavy apron and broad padded belt. Holds a compact sealed rectangular feed tin against left hip and small measuring cup in right clawed hand. Civilian work attire, no armor.
